# Wyrd

> Wyrd is the declarative AI layer for developers, engineers, and agents. A standardized ecosystem for models, data, prompts, agents, workflows, evals, policies, audits, services, sources, and observations. Runtime tools resolve through tool registries; execution stays in the user runtime.

## Home

- [Wyrd](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/): The typed control layer for AI systems: cards, a registry, and the Skald runtime.

## Start here

- [How it connects](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/start-here/how-it-connects/): The card system, the registry, and the Skald runtime — and how a component flows through them.
- [Quickstart](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/start-here/quickstart/): Run the local DataCard workflow from the Wyrd repo.
- [What is Wyrd](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/start-here/what-is-wyrd/): The typed control layer for the components of an AI system — cards, a registry, and the Skald runtime.

## Cards

- [Cards overview](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/cards/): The card envelope, how registration works, and a catalog of every card kind with its status.
- [Data](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/cards/data/): Generated reference for the Wyrd Data card spec.
- [Model](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/cards/model/): Generated reference for the Wyrd Model card spec.
- [Prompt](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/cards/prompt/): Generated reference for the Wyrd Prompt card spec.

## Skald runtime

- [Agents & workflows](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/skald/): Skald — Wyrd's runtime for defining agents and workflows once and running them from Python or Rust.

## Guides

- [Build an Agent Workflow](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/guides/build-a-workflow/): Author a workflow from Python, YAML, or Rust, then run and instrument it.
- [Build an Agent](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/guides/build-an-agent/): Build a Wyrd Agent: prompt, tools, callbacks, session memory, and run config. Python and Rust side-by-side.
- [DataCard local workflow](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/guides/data-card-local-workflow/): Create a DataCard, save it locally, load it back, and inspect the local files.

## Agents

- [For agents](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/agents/): How an agent should read and update Wyrd — stable paths, a copyable workflow, and the rules.
- [Error remediation](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/agents/error-remediation/): How agents should handle Wyrd errors.

## Evaluation

- [Evaluate agents](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/evaluation/): Score agent runs against the same task definitions in CI and against collected production records, with run_eval and the wyrd eval CLI.

## Server

- [Run the server](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/server/): Stand up wyrd-server against Postgres and object storage — local dev and production.
- [Authentication](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/server/auth/): API keys, Wyrd JWTs, and OIDC federation — how callers prove who they are.
- [Register cards to a server](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/server/register-cards/): How a local card becomes a durable, versioned record in the registry.

## Python

- [Python](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/python/): Public Python imports and local DataCard behavior.

## API reference

- [Errors](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/api/errors/): Error handling guidance for Wyrd API clients and agents.
- [OpenAPI](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/api/openapi/): Generated summary of the Wyrd OpenAPI contract.
- [Schemas](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/api/schemas/): Generated inventory of Wyrd JSON Schemas.

## Roadmap

- [Roadmap](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/roadmap/): What is specified or in progress but not yet runnable — stated honestly.

## Machine-readable schemas

- [llms-full.txt](https://mitari-ai.github.io/wyrd/llms-full.txt): every card JSON Schema plus this page index.
- JSON Schemas: see `crates/wyrd-spec/schemas/` in the wyrd repository. `architecture/wyrd-design.md` remains the design authority while schemas are reconciled.
